headline: 10-year Treasury yield hits 5% for first time since 2023 as traders brace for Fed decision this week
detail: Higher yields make future earnings less valuable, directly hurting growth stocks like tech and chips. This is a major headwind for your concentrated portfolio, especially on margin.
rec: Consider trimming QQQ and SMH, which are already on TRIM status, as higher rates directly pressure their valuations.

headline: AI stocks slide after major CEOs unite to urge slowdown
detail: This indicates potential cooling or uncertainty in the AI sector, a significant component of your tech/chip holdings. It could signal broader tech weakness ahead.
rec: Monitor your tech/chip holdings closely for further downside, especially those with negative P&L or TRIM/SELL status.

headline: Brent crude tops $106 after Saudi Arabia shuts down critical pipeline that bypasses Strait of Hormuz
detail: Rising oil prices contribute to inflation concerns, which can push interest rates higher. This is a macro headwind that could further pressure growth stocks and your core tech holdings.
rec: Avoid adding to tech/chip positions as rising energy costs could exacerbate inflation and rate hike fears, hurting your core holdings.
